resources.string: Enable Developer options: open Settings > About phone and tap \"Build number\" 7 times.
Open Settings > System > Developer options, find \"Select mock location app\" and choose FakeGPS.
Move the map so the red marker sits on the place you want to fake.
Tap the green play button to start faking. Tap the red stop button to stop. Tap the ? button on the side to see this guide again.
